description: Twelve stage programmer and stage sequencer loosely after the Serge TKB. One stage is active at a time, and each stage holds five voltages, a trigger setting and a repeat count

params.text: Selects the active stage by hand
Multiplies the five voltages of that stage by 5, and lights green while it is on
The voltage the A output carries while that stage is active, 0V to 2V
The voltage the B output carries while that stage is active, 0V to 2V
The voltage the C output carries while that stage is active, 0V to 2V
The voltage the D output carries while that stage is active, -1V to 1V
The voltage the E output carries while that stage is active, -1V to 1V
Makes that stage the active one, and lights while that stage is active
Steps that stage through four modes shown by its colour: yellow sends its voltages and its trigger, blue sends the voltages alone, dark grey passes over it, red sends the sequence back to its start
How many pulses that stage's trigger output sends when the sequence is clocked, 1 to 8, spread as subdivisions of the step
Makes a clocked sequence step upward through the stages rather than downward
Sends the sequencer to stage 12, or to stage 1 while it is stepping upward, so the next clock starts the sequence again
Makes the sequencer pick the next stage at random
Randomises the settings of every stage, the x5 buttons, the modes and the repeat knobs along with the voltage knobs; it works only with the shift key held down
How many steps the mode column rotates on each incoming clock, and in which direction
How much of the voltage at the rotation CV input reaches the rotation

inputs.text: A voltage selects the active stage, read at a twelfth of a volt per stage so a keyboard can pick the stages
A pulse advances the sequencer one stage
A trigger switches between stepping upward and stepping downward
A trigger starts the sequencer running
A trigger sends the sequencer to stage 12, or to stage 1 while it is stepping upward
A trigger randomises the settings of every stage, the x5 buttons, the modes and the repeat knobs along with the voltage knobs
A trigger jumps the sequencer straight to that stage; with triggers arriving at several stages at once the highest numbered one wins
Takes the A output of a second one of these, so the two run as one longer sequence
Takes the B output of a second one of these, so the two run as one longer sequence
Takes the C output of a second one of these, so the two run as one longer sequence
Takes the D output of a second one of these, so the two run as one longer sequence
Takes the E output of a second one of these, so the two run as one longer sequence
Takes the common trigger output of a second one of these, so the two run as one longer sequence
A voltage moving the rotation of the mode column
Audio or a voltage here reaches that stage's bridge output while the stage is active
A voltage here is used in place of that stage's A knob

outputs.text: Carries the A voltage of the active stage
Carries the B voltage of the active stage
Carries the C voltage of the active stage
Carries the D voltage of the active stage
Carries the E voltage of the active stage
Sends a pulse whenever any stage sends its trigger, so the triggers of the whole sequence arrive on one cable
Sends a pulse each time a clocked sequence finishes a pass; nothing comes out while the sequencer is being driven by the select knob or its CV
Passes the incoming clock on, for driving a second one of these from the same clock
Sends a pulse when that stage becomes the active one, or the several pulses set by that stage's repeat knob
High for as long as that stage is the active one
Carries whatever is at that stage's bridge input while that stage is active

notes: with nothing at the clock input and the sequencer not started, the active stage changes only by the select knob, the stage select CV, a stage's own trigger input or a press on a stage button.
menu: RANDOMIZE CV LINE A — takes that line in or out of what the randomiser changes, with RANDOMIZE CV LINE B, C, D and E beside it
RANDOMIZE REP(etitions) — takes the ratchet repetitions in or out of what the randomiser changes, with RANDOMIZE DIRECTION, RANDOMIZE x5 multiplier and RANDOMIZE MODE beside it
RANDOMIZE RANGE — how far the randomiser moves a setting from where it stands: RANDOMIZE FULL, RANDOMIZE 20%, RANDOMIZE 10% or RANDOMIZE 5%
SCALES — snaps the five CV outputs to one of eighteen preset scales; NO QUANTIZER, the default, passes the knob voltages as they are
